questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Venezuela?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Venezuela article.

questions.proof: The official language is Spanish, and the capital city is Caracas.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In regard to inflation: It is between "20% and 30% a month", according to an estimate quoted (November _____) by a media outlet; The estimate is for the capital city.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Venezuela article, under the heading “Economy”.

questions.proof: In regard to inflation: It is between "20% and 30% a month", according to an estimate quoted (November 2025) by a media outlet; The estimate is for the capital city.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The Crisis in Venezuela started in _____ (and has been ongoing for 16 years, 5 months, 1 week and 2 days.)”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Venezuela article, under the heading “After independence (1823)”.

questions.proof: The Crisis in Venezuela started in 2010 (and has been ongoing for 16 years, 5 months, 1 week and 2 days.)
